rules.rationale: This simplification rule is a guarded Boolean identity used to normalize the target proof obligation. It does not define a named summary or execute the modeled program, and Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before proving the target rather than first proving the exact rule in a module that omits it, so it remains a trusted domain fact.

This simplification rule is the complementary guarded Boolean identity for the other short-circuit branch. It is neither a definitional equation nor an operational execution rule, and no Stage 1 command first proves the exact rule against a rule-free module, so it is an additional trusted mathematical fact.
